content: Mmbe, abhahiiri bhaanɨ, bhanʉ Mungu arʉbhwɨrɨ kʉbha abharɨndu bhaazɨ, mwiseege igʉrʉ wa Yɨɨsu, Umutumwa wa Mungu na ni‑Kuhaani Ʉmʉkʉrʉ wʉnʉ tukwisirirya.
Ewe aarɨ moronge kwa Mungu wʉnʉ aamʉrʉbhwɨrɨ, chɨmburya Musa
wʉʉsi aarɨ moronge kʉbhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bha munyumba ya Mungu.
Umwʉmbaki ahaahaabhwa ubhusuuku kʉkɨra inyumba yɨnʉ ʉmbakirɨ. Muyomuyo Yɨɨsu wʉʉsi areenderwa kukumibhwa bhʉkʉngʼu kʉkɨra Musa.
Zinyumba zʉʉsi zɨrʉʉmbakwa na abhʉʉmbaki obhorebhe, nawe Mungu newe Umwʉmbaki Ʉmʉkʉrʉ we ebhegero bhyʉsi.
Musa aarɨ omohocha omoheene kʉbhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bha munyumba ya Mungu. Emeremo jazɨ jarɨ nɨ‑jʉ ʉkʉbhʉʉrɨra abhaatʉ amangʼana gʉʉsi ganʉ Mungu akwenda kʉgamba ribhaga rɨnʉ rikuuza.

Nawe Kiriisitʉ, ewe ni‑Mwana moheene wʉnʉ akwimɨɨrɨrɨra abhaatʉ bha munyumba ya Mungu. Na abhaatʉ bha munyumba yiyo niitwɨ, arɨɨbhɨ tʉrangʼeha kʉnaga mʉbhʉkararu bhwɨtʉ nʉ ʉkʉbha no obhoheene bhwa ganʉ tukwisega.

content.text: chɨmbu bhawʉsʉʉkʉrʉ bhaarɨ bhakwanga ʉkʉkangatwa na niinyɨ,
Kʉkɨbhara iyo nɨyu bhasʉʉkʉrʉ bhaanyu bhaarɨ bhakongema,
nangabha nɨkabhakorera ɨbhɨsɨgʉ bhyaru kumyaka merongo ene.
Mmbe igʉrʉ wa riyo nikiigatanɨra urwibhʉrʉ ruyo, nɨkabhuga,
‘Sikʉ zʉʉsi nɨ‑bhaatʉ bhanʉ bharimiirɨ zekoro zaabhʉ,

content: Abhahiiri bhaanɨ, mwangarɨrɨ, korereke ataaza kʉbhaho ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi gatɨ waanyu wʉnʉ anu umwʉyʉ ʉmʉbhɨ, gʉnʉ gʉtakwisirirya, na kwahʉka kurwa kwa Mungu wʉ ʉbhʉhʉru.
Nawe mwihaanɨ umwʉyʉ imubheene kobheene zisikʉ zʉʉsi zɨnʉ tʉkʉbhɨrɨkɨra “Reero,” korereke ataaza kʉbhaho gatɨ waanyu ʉmʉʉtʉ wu umwʉyʉ ʉmʉkʉngʼu gwʉ ʉkʉkangiribhwa nʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ.
Kʉgayo tʉragwatana na Kiriisitʉ arɨɨbhɨ tʉrakaja kumwisega kuhika mʉtɨnɨrʉ, chɨmbu twarɨ tʉramwisega kwɨma ʉbhʉtangɨ.

content.text: chɨmbu bhawʉsʉʉkʉrʉ bhaarɨ bhakwanga ʉkʉkangatwa na niinyɨ.”

content: Nangʉ, nɨ‑bhaatʉkɨ bhanʉ bhiigwirɨ riraka rya Mungu, nawe bhakaanga kʉkangatwa nawe? Ɨtarɨ bhanʉ bhʉʉsi bhaarɨ bhakʉkangatwa na Musa kurwa mucharʉ cha Miisiri?
Na nɨ‑bhaatʉkɨ bhanʉ Mungu igataniirɨ kumyaka merongo ene? Ɨtarɨ bhanʉ bhaakʉrirɨ ʉbhʉbhɨ, bhakakwa kʉkɨbhara?
Na nɨ‑bhaatʉkɨ bhanʉ Mungu akiirahɨra kʉbha atakubhisiririrya kusikɨra ahagero hu ukwoyeera hanʉ akʉnzirɨ igʉrʉ waabhʉ? Ɨtarɨ bhanʉ bhaangirɨ kwigwa?
Mmbe, tʉrarora abhaatʉ bhayo bhakatamwa kusikɨra ahagero hu ukwoyeera, kʉ kʉbha bhaangirɨ kwisirirya Mungu.

footnotes.text: a Musa. Kʉmaragɨrɨra bhʉkʉngʼu, rora Ikiniibhasa.
